held.why: REFUSED: Script bounds the reading to 'line 31 to the end of line 32' then says 'Find the words no other help at hand', but 'help at hand to summon' is on line 33, outside the range it sets; 'tucked into a dash' is also an unexplained device a child cannot act on.

REFUSED: Supports only the first half of the key (wants the mark gone, lines 26-27); never shows the half that separates it from the distractors, that she asks nothing about whose blood it is. 'That is a housekeeping answer' is a label the child must decode, not evidence, and 'how horrid' is left unaddressed against the 'frightened' option.

REFUSED: Never connects the weighing of two wants to the act the question asks about ('So she shut her eyes quite close', line 35), and 'Line 34 says which of the two won' misplaces the deciding words, which are 'cared less' on line 33; the 'pure sacrifice' option ('did not extend so far', line 33) is left unaddressed.

REFUSED: 'Line 51 has Tom say no again and start to back away' claims something the passage does not say; line 51 is "Well, here—No, Ben, now don't. I'm afeard—", with no backing away (he half-offers, then refuses).
